subject.title: [AI-assisted] Preserve thread sessions across daily reset by default

question: Should OpenClaw accept `sessionClosedAt` as durable core session-entry state and a reserved plugin slot for closed thread/channel rollover?
rationale: The code path is a plausible best fix for the reported closed-thread/no-expiry bug, but adding persisted core session state and excluding that key from plugin slots is a compatibility/API decision that automation should not finalize.

options.title: Accept durable marker
options.body: Approve `sessionClosedAt` as core session lifecycle state, refresh the branch on current main, and merge after focused session proof stays green.

options.title: Narrow the state surface
options.body: Ask the author to keep closed-thread rollover internal or plugin-local until maintainers choose a permanent session-store contract.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Close or pause the branch if maintainers do not want a new durable session marker for archived/closed channel lifecycle events.

recommendation.title: Accept durable marker
recommendation.body: Approve `sessionClosedAt` as core session lifecycle state, refresh the branch on current main, and merge after focused session proof stays green.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session thread management and docs work make this the clearest owner for the durable session-state contract decision.
